page_title: PAR 3-3 LYO | Paris FC v Lyon 29/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+10' Tyler Morton (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90+7' The referee shows the yellow card to Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC).
90+6' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the top left corner is saved by Obed Nkambadio.
90+5' Tyler Morton (Lyon) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+2' Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
88' The Paris FC players are exchanging some short passes.
85' Jorge Maciel prepares a substitution. Pavel Sulc is replaced by Martin Satriano (Lyon).
84' 3 - 3 Goal! Ilan Kebbal passes the ball to Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Dominik Greif couldn't do anything about it. 3:3.
82' The substitution is prepared. Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pierre Lees-Melou.
81' Tyler Morton (Lyon) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area. The opposition's defence outnumbers the attacking players inside the box and they manage to make a clearance.
79' Poor challenge! Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) is penalised for tripping and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. Lyon have a free kick.
77' 2 - 3 Goal! Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 2:3.
75' Moses Simon (Paris FC) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Hans Hateboer (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Afonso Moreira.
73' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC).
71' It is time for a substitution. Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) is on for Adama Camara.
71' Stephane Gilli decides to make a substitution. Willem Geubbels will be replaced by Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC).
68' Jorge Maciel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) replacing Corentin Tolisso.
68' Substitution. Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) replaces Adam Karabec.
67' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Paris FC comes to nothing.
65' 1 - 3 What a cracking goal that is! Adama Camara (Paris FC) latched on to an inch-perfect cross just outside the box and arrows the ball into the top left corner. Glorious strike.
61' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
58' 0 - 3 Goal! Pavel Sulc (Lyon) dribbles into the box then perfectly lifts the ball over the goalkeeper and into the net. He couldn't do anything to stop that cheeky lob. 0:3.
55' The free kick is delivered by Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
55' Mathys de Carvalho (Lyon) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Jeremy Stinat's book.
55' The referee blows his whistle as Adam Karabec (Lyon) was too aggressive in his challenge.
51' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Pavel Sulc (Lyon) receives a precise pass inside the box from Afonso Moreira and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
49' Obed Nkambadio (Paris FC) attempts to find Moses Simon with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
48' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Willem Geubbels (Paris FC), who plants a header just over the bar from close range.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Jeremy Stinat has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+1' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' A corner kick by Paris FC is thwarted by the well prepared Dominik Greif (Lyon).
45' Moses Simon (Paris FC) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Paris FC are awarded a corner kick.
43' The Paris FC players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
41' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
39' That's unlucky! Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
38' Samir Chergui (Paris FC) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
37' Adam Karabec (Lyon) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
37' Adam Karabec (Lyon) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
35' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
32' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Adama Camara (Paris FC), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
32' The foul by Pavel Sulc (Lyon) was seen by Jeremy Stinat who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
30' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Afonso Moreira (Lyon) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
30' Adam Karabec (Lyon) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Pavel Sulc latches onto his pass.
28' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
27' Tyler Morton (Lyon) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
27' Lyon will take a free kick.
26' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
26' Looks like Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
25' Yellow card. Samir Chergui (Paris FC) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
25' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Stephane Gilli is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Jonathan Ikone suffers an injury and Moses Simon (Paris FC) comes on.
23' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
20' Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) commits a foul during an attacking move.
17' It seemed like Adam Karabec (Lyon) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
12' Jeremy Stinat couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Samir Chergui (Paris FC) and blew his whistle.

9' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lyon are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
5' Corentin Tolisso is able to continue with the attacking effort as he latches on to a beautiful defence-splitting lofted pass, which was supplied by Dominik Greif (Lyon).
4' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Afonso Moreira (Lyon) offside.
1' It looks like Otavio (Paris FC) saw red with that tackle. Jeremy Stinat won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Lyon will have the kick-off.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
